Dear Hannah,

How are you? We're very well. We're getting ready
for our summer party. My brother and I are helping
Mom and Dad. We're cooking and cleaning the
apartment together.

+

Look at this photo. 1am with my mom and Aunt Lola.
We're choosing party dresses. I like the green and
white dress.

Look. We like the yellow invitations with purple letters.
What do you think?

And here, we're choosing party cakes. My brother likes
the little cakes. I like the big chocolate cake.

Write soon.

Love from Bella
